class.name: SteamScoreOptions
class.brief_description: Branchable score submission options tied to the originating Steam client scope.
class.description: Start from [method SteamLeaderboards.with_details] or [method SteamLeaderboards.with_replay]. Each modifier returns an independent branch. [method submit_score] starts the submission.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Submits the signed 32-bit score to an existing board using keep-best. If Steam reports that the score became the entry, attaches the requested replay. Use [code]await[/code] to receive a [SteamLeaderboardSubmissionResult]. The accepted receipt remains available if attachment fails.

method.name: with_details
method.description: Returns a branch that sends these details with the score. The submission accepts at most 64 signed 32-bit integers.

method.name: with_replay
method.description: Returns a branch requesting attachment of the provided Steam Remote Storage shared-file handle. Pass a nonzero decimal handle belonging to this app.
